titles.romaji: Shitsuke Bideo Hello Kitty to Issho
titles.native: ハローキティといっしょ

description:
Growing Up With Hello Kitty is an educational short DVD series that ran from 1994 to 1998. It has the characters of Hello Kitty learning manners, kindness, and other life lessons.

In 2012, AnimEigo licensed 12 of the 16 episodes for English release.
